root_cause: The pikaday keyboard listener attached to document processes ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Down keys regardless of which element has focus, preventing normal text field caret movement when the calendar is visible.
repair_strategy: Add an early return in Pikaday._onKeyChange when the bound field is not the active element, so arrow keys only adjust the date picker when the associated input has focus.
expected_accessibility_effect: Users can now use left/right arrow keys to correct typos in text fields while the date picker is visible, restoring expected editing behavior.
functional_risks: Arrow keys will no longer change the selected date when focus is outside the bound input (e.g., in other form fields). This is the intended behavior; date navigation via arrow keys remains available when the input itself is focused.
verification_requirements: Press ArrowLeft in the #notes field while the calendar is visible and verify the caret moves left.
Press ArrowRight/Up/Down in the #notes field and verify normal text navigation works.
Focus the #delivery-date field and verify ArrowLeft/Right/Up/Still change the selected date as before.
Confirm that date selection via mouse clicks in the calendar continues to work.
Ensure the calendar still opens/closes correctly and bound field updates on selection.
